entry.title: Instrument First: Ben Eater's 6502 on Breadboards

entry.title: How I Build Software with AI, According to My Transcripts
entry.summary: Mining ~700 of my own prompts from nine Claude Code sessions across four Rust projects to find the workflow I actually use: prime with context, plan twice, delegate in numbered batches, review with fresh eyes, and keep the hands-on testing for yourself.

entry.title: Three Threads from Onboarding a CNC
